# @codenhub/i18n

> Translations with typed keys and values, ICU messages, CLDR plurals, `Intl` formatters, and regional and default-locale fallback, plus an optional browser binding and localized-path routing with translated paths and a `localePrefix` of `"always"`, `"except-default"`, or `"when-ambiguous"`.

Use only the root, `/browser`, and `/routing` entry points. Await `init()`, or `initializeBrowserI18n()` in a browser, before calling `t()`, `has()`, or `setLocale()`. Create one manager per request or page on a server or in a static build. A key missing from every dictionary returns the trimmed key and warns once per locale and key unless `isSilent` is set. Messages do not render HTML and do not support number skeletons or styles such as `{n, number, currency}`; use `formatNumber()`. `createLocaleRouting()` requires `localePrefix`. In a Web Worker, pass `syncDocument: false` and no `root` to `initializeBrowserI18n()`.

## Documentation

- [Overview](docs/index.md): Core ideas, a walkthrough, missing-key behavior, right-to-left direction, manager state and events, and turning outside input into a locale.
- [Write your translations](docs/translations.md): Dictionary rules, JSON loaders with timeouts, regional variants, ICU messages, formatters, plurals, typed keys and values, key-parity and message tests, and size limits.
- [Translate a browser app](docs/browser.md): Locale detection order, persistence, `lang`/`dir` sync, framework re-rendering, `data-i18n` and form controls, and Web Workers.
- [Render on a server or at build time](docs/server-rendering.md): Per-request managers, `Accept-Language` matching, logging, static builds, and handing the locale to the browser.
- [Localized URLs](docs/localized-urls.md): Translated paths, `localePrefix` including `"when-ambiguous"`, `parse`, `localize`, `localizeAll`, static-site detection, and accepted paths.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Every error and warning, with its message and fix.
- [API reference](docs/reference/index.md): Generated reference for every export.
